data.answer: SparkCharge is mentioned as a company that appeared on ABC's "Shark Tank" in Season 12, Episode 1, which aired on October 16, 2020. The company was pitched by an entrepreneur from Austin, Texas, who aimed to electrify fleets without commitments. SparkCharge also raised $30 million to help fleets electrify, as reported in a TechCrunch Industry News Podcast Republic episode from May 21, 2025.
